subject.name_or_desc: United Kingdom European Union membership referendum

context.question: Will Britain vote to leave the European Union in the referendum of 23 June 2016?
context.asked_at: Assessment first published 5 July 2015; firmed up 22 February 2016
context.setting: The referendum date has just been announced: 23 June 2016. Newspaper polls in February 2016 show 'Stay' ahead, with vast numbers of 'not sure' voters. Available charts include the UK national charts for 1066, 1801 and 1922; on referendum day Uranus and Ceres conjunct at 23 degrees Aries.

provenance.work: Jessica Adams, 'How Astrology Predicts a Brexit', jessicaadams.com, 22 February 2016 (referencing her 5 July 2015 'GOODBYE EU' post)
